title: GDD T-104 — MECH_04 ¡APUNTA! hold-charge aiming microgame (§4 MECH_04, IMicrogame contract §10.2)
description: Highest-priority mechanic. Pure Barcade.Core sim implementing IMicrogame (§10.2). Rules per §4 MECH_04: each player owns a corner turret in normalized [0,1]² space; the stick sets one of 8 discrete angles (the 0.25 s interpolation is presentation — sim tracks the discrete angle plus an interp factor exposed via RenderState); holding the button charges with the oscillating meter p(t) = 0.5*(1 + sin(w*t_hold)) where the full cycle lasts chargeCycleSec (1.2 s default); release fires a ballistic projectile (angle, p); targets appear at seeded positions in the central zone. Scoring: most hits in duration; tiebreak by summed precision (distance to target center). Edge cases from the GDD: button still held at timeout auto-fires with current power (nobody loses their shot); two projectiles hitting the same target the same tick — higher precision scores, the other passes to the next target if one exists. Params: chargeCycleSec, targetCount, targetMoving (enabled+speed), windAccel, projectileSpeedMin/Max, duration. Read GDD §4 MECH_04, §10.2, Annex D.2. Uses the TASK-023 InputInterpreter for hold tracking.
acceptance_criteria: Implements the IMicrogame contract as engine-free Core code; all randomness through injected SeededRandom
Charge power follows p(t)=0.5*(1+sin(w*t_hold)) with full cycle = chargeCycleSec; a hold of duration d starting at the same tick always yields the same power (determinism test)
Release fires a ballistic projectile parameterized by (discrete angle, power); trajectories are deterministic in logical [0,1]² space; windAccel variant shifts trajectories deterministically
Targets spawn at seeded central-zone positions honoring targetCount and targetMoving params; every target is reachable from all 4 corners for every test seed (solver test, GDD AC2)
Button still held when duration expires auto-fires with the instantaneous power (timeout test, GDD AC3)
Two projectiles on the same target in the same tick: the more precise one scores, the other passes to the next remaining target if any (edge-case test)
Result ranks by hit count with summed-precision tiebreak; same-tick equal outcomes share Place
Steady-state Tick allocates zero heap memory (projectiles pooled)
Tests-first: red tests for each AC committed strictly before implementation; fast suite green after, no regression

comments.author: developer
comments.body: Implemented tests-first on master by dev-t101, no push, no Unity. Commits: a6337ed test(core) failing ApuntaMicrogame v2 spec (16 tests; red = 2x CS0246 on the not-yet-existing ApuntaParams, captured before ANY production file existed) -> c7c0322 test(core) two pre-implementation test-setup fixes (same-tick-contest test was tie-by-construction via mirror-symmetric shots; two tests held button only 1 tick which T-101's 2-tick debounce never confirms) -> 847d43b feat(core) ApuntaMicrogame v2. Suite 378 -> 394 green. Files: V2/ApuntaParams.cs, V2/ApuntaMicrogame.cs, MicrogameId.cs (+Apunta), Tests/EditMode/ApuntaMicrogameV2Tests.cs (+metas, 3 hand-minted collision-checked). Contract: current GDD-literal v2 (Initialize(SeededRandom,PlayerRoster,float), Tick(in InputSnapshot)); flagged that the original briefing's ISeededRandom mention was stale vs a7c59ab — followed master's literal contract. DESIGN ASSUMPTIONS (GDD silent, flagged for reviewer): (1) HitRadius 0.18, central zone [0.4,0.6]^2, projectile speed 0.45-0.95 — solver-verified reachable across 150 seeds x 3 targets x 4 corners via brute-force numerical solver (8 directions x 400 power samples using the sim's own landing math); (2) fixed ProjectileFlightSeconds 0.3 independent of power/distance; (3) same-tick contest = greedy nearest-pair matching, cascades to further targets; (4) ranking = hits desc then summed precision asc, competition ranking (1,1,3). Aiming rules (GDD gaps, pinned by tests): aim reads live 8-way RawDirection; stick None holds last non-None aim; cold-start default = corner-to-center diagonal so no turret faces out of arena. Risks/notes: InputBridge ~15 lines DUPLICATED from ReaccionaMicrogame (deliberate — Reacciona review was in flight; follow-up cleanup ticket candidate); WindAccel shifts landing X only (documented choice); PoolCapacity 32 / FeedbackCapacity 16 with silent-drop defensive guards (mash-ring precedent); difficultyMult accepted but no-op (GDD defines no MECH_04 scaling); two ApuntaParams validation checks relaxed > to >= to permit degenerate param spaces (single-point zone, fixed speed).

comments.author: reviewer
comments.body: FULL-depth fresh-context review (rev-t026) of a7c59ab..847d43b, evidence pinned at 847d43b in a detached worktree: REQUEST-CHANGES — 1 HIGH, 3 MEDIUM, 5 LOW. Suite 394/394 observed pinned. Commit order + compile-red verified from tree state; c7c0322 judged LEGITIMATE pre-impl test-authoring corrections (old contest setup tied by mirror symmetry — even a wrong impl passed; 1-tick holds were unpassable against the pre-existing 2-tick debounce; both fixes strengthen the sensors). HIGH-1 (ApuntaMicrogame.cs:244-283): firing is not gated on round duration — the overtime window kept open for in-flight shots still runs the per-seat charge/fire loop; (A) hold through expiry -> auto-fire at durationTicks-1, then releasing within ~0.25 s fires a SECOND projectile from the same physical hold which can score and change ranking (violates GDD §4 'más impactos en duration' and the code's own last-active-tick comment); (B) liveness: each overtime fire extends AnyProjectileActive ~18 ticks vs ~4-tick min fire cycle -> mashing keeps IsFinished false indefinitely, future sequencer hangs. Fix shape: gate charge accumulation + fire on _tick < durationTicks; overtime only MoveTargets/ResolveArrivals/PublishRenderState. Timeout test never releases so it cannot see this. MEDIUM-1: vacuous zero-alloc window, THIRD occurrence of the class — 982/1000 measured ticks are post-IsFinished no-ops; Fire path never measured, CueHit never executes anywhere in the test (both shots geometrically miss). MEDIUM-2: render contract gap — in-flight projectiles never published (EntityKind.Projectile exists but Entities capacity SeatCount+TargetCount cannot hold them); no charge-meter value exposed (Annex D.2 HudState 'medidores'; the meter is THE visual the player times); GDD §4's '8 direcciones interpoladas a 0.25 s' clause silently dropped — the ticket description explicitly requires an interp factor in RenderState. MEDIUM-3: targetMoving entirely untested (MoveTargets + velocity spawn zero coverage) AND latent defect: single-reflection bounce diverges when zone span < per-tick movement (amplitude grows unboundedly; reachable with valid ctor args via the relaxed >= validation, not with GddDefaults). LOWs: (1) AC5 power-at-timeout never asserted; (2) AC6 positive cascade branch untested (algorithm traced correct); (3) InputBridge copies ALREADY diverge textually (normalized diagonals vs ±1 vectors; identical only while ToDirection8 is sign-only) -> consolidation ticket; (4) difficultyMult no-op comment claims 'GDD defines no MECH_04 scaling' — factually wrong, GDD 11.1's example IS MECH_04 and declares difficultyScaling [targetMoving.speed, windAccel]; deferral to T-106 is defensible, stating it as a GDD fact is calibration laundering — fix comment; (5) flight-vs-pool invariant unguarded (flight >= ~0.54 s at max cadence makes silent shot-drop reachable; guard ctor or document). Positive verdicts: charge math GDD-literal w=2pi/cycle (no factor-of-2 error); solver test genuine (quantization margin analysis: max landing gap ~0.022 << 0.18 hitRadius); 'nobody loses their shot' honored (overtime resolution works — the gate must not remove it); ranking parity with Reacciona confirmed; MicrogameId append-only; metas clean. Pre-existing repo-wide duplicate .meta GUID (8404be70..., TASK-006 era, ArcadeControls vs InputSystem_Actions) -> separate hygiene ticket. Tier-audit: tdd correct and honored. Disposition: fix round HIGH-1 + M1/M2/M3 + LOWs 1/2/4/5 (LOW-3 excluded, separate ticket); rev-t026 re-verifies.

comments.author: developer
comments.body: Fix round complete on master (dev-t101): f433e1a test(core) red fix-round tests -> 4408774 fix(core). Reacciona files untouched as instructed. Red evidence verbatim: 7 failed pre-fix for the findings' exact reasons — double-fire (Expected 1 But was 2), unbounded overtime (IsFinished never true), no Projectile entity published (Expected 1 But was 0), charge meter 0.0 vs expected live value, interp progress stuck 0, and both moving-target divergence cases escaping the zone; 18 other new tests were already-green regression locks. HIGH-1: entire per-seat aim/charge/fire block (release-fire AND timeout auto-fire) gated on _tick < durationTicks; overtime runs only MoveTargets/ResolveArrivals/PublishRenderState; hold-then-release-in-overtime fires exactly once; overtime mashing reaches IsFinished within durationTicks + flightTicks + 10. MEDIUM-2: (a) in-flight shots publish as EntityKind.Projectile (linear launch->landing interpolation over fixed flight), RenderState capacity pre-sized SeatCount+TargetCount+PoolCapacity at construction; (b) NEW ADDITIVE FIELD HudState.Meters (float[4]) — live oscillating charge power while holding (NOTE: touches the shared V2 HudState contract type — additive per its documented pattern); (c) per-seat _aimChangeTick; RenderEntity.VisualVariant on PlayerAvatar encodes 0-255 progress through the GDD 0.25 s interp window — sim still snaps aim instantly, purely a presentation hint, documented. MEDIUM-3: mirror-reflection replaced by clamp-to-boundary with inward-forced velocity — hard guarantee against divergence for any span/speed ratio incl. degenerate zero-span (stationary); 3 tests (determinism / pathological ratio bounds / degenerate zone). MEDIUM-1: alloc sensor rebuilt per the REACCIONA pattern — long duration, 150 co-located targets, repeating 4-tick press/release firing a real projectile every cycle, at least one CueHit resolving INSIDE the measured window, IsFinished==false asserted before and after; measures 0 bytes through Fire + hit resolution + the new publication code. LOWs: (1) timeout test now asserts LastLandingX/Y against analytically computed ChargePower at the auto-fire tick; (2) SameTickTwoTargets_LoserCascadesToSecondTargetAndScores pins the positive cascade (2 distinct targets scored); (4) difficultyMult comment fixed — GDD 11.1's MECH_04 example DOES declare difficultyScaling [targetMoving.speed, windAccel]; wiring deferred to T-106, stated explicitly; (5) flight-vs-pool threshold documented with exact derivation (32/60 ≈ 0.533 s at 4-seat max cadence) on ProjectileFlightSeconds rather than a cross-type ctor guard — dev's call, flagged. Suite 397 -> 406 green (9 new). Commits sit on top of d04708d (TASK-025 close chore).
